lamborghini-aventador.author: Mike BlueG
lamborghini-aventador.changes: Removed staging/people where present. Baked world transforms, normalized scale and +Z forward/+Y up coordinates. Preserved authored normals/UVs; separated whole wheel components into articulated pivots. Conservatively simplified secondary geometry with normals/UV weights, merged compatible material batches without changing vertex data, corrected named material roles where archived viewport shading was unsuitable for PBR, resized embedded textures and Meshopt-compressed for delivery.
